=== R1 unresolved call returns the statement that runs
<?php
$db = new PDO('mysql:host=h', 'u', 'p');
$id = $_GET['id'];
$s = $db->prepare('SELECT a FROM u WHERE id = :id');
$s->bindParam(':id', $id);
other($s)->execute();

$s->bindParam(':id', $id);
($x ? $s : $t)->execute();

 public $db;

}
$r = new R; decorate($r); $r->go();

=== R7 ArrayAccess
<?php
$db = new PDO('m');
class Req implements ArrayAccess { function offsetGet($k): mixed { global $s, $db; $s = $db->prepare('SELECT a FROM u WHERE id = ' . $_GET['z']); return 1; } function offsetExists($k): bool { return true; } function offsetSet($k, $v): void {} function offsetUnset($k): void {} }
$id = $_GET['id']; $req = new Req;
$s = $db->prepare('SELECT a FROM u WHERE id = :id');
$s->bindParam(':id', $id);
$s->bindValue(':n', $req['n']);
$s->execute();
=== R7 __toString

<?php
$db = mysqli_connect('h', 'u', 'p', 'd');
mysqli_query($db, "SET SESSION sql_mode='NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES'");
$v = mysqli_real_escape_string($db, $_POST['v']);
mysqli_query($db, "SELECT a FROM t WHERE b = \"$v\"");
=== R24 escape of another engine
<?php
$db = mysqli_connect('h', 'u', 'p', 'd');
$l = new SQLite3('a.db');
$v = mysqli_real_escape_string($db, $_POST['v']);
$l->query("SELECT a FROM t WHERE b = '$v'");
